\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 140-143 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R148-first-pass-words-from-chapters-140-143}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to get a flat tyre and to get stuck.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to open, to wipe, to switch on, to switch off, to wake up
  \item to lose, to find, to give back, to settle the bill, to order
  \item to wait, to suggest, to choose, to catch a cold, to get hurt
  \item to swallow, to forget, to teach, to fill, to hand in
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To open? (\textbf{\fa{باز} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{bâz kardan}.) To wipe? (\textbf{\fa{پاک} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{pâk kardan}.) To switch on? (\textbf{\fa{روشن} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{roshan kardan}.) To switch off? (\textbf{\fa{خاموش} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{khâmush kardan}.) To wake up? (\textbf{\fa{بیدار} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{bidâr shodan}.) To lose? (\textbf{\fa{گم} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{gom kardan}.) To find? (\textbf{\fa{پیدا} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{peydâ kardan}.) To give back? (\textbf{\fa{پس} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{pas dâdan}.) To settle the bill? (\textbf{\fa{حساب} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{hesâb kardan}.) To order? (\textbf{\fa{سفارش} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{sefâresh dâdan}.) To wait? (\textbf{\fa{صبر} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{sabr kardan}.) To suggest? (\textbf{\fa{پیشنهاد} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{pishnahâd kardan}.) To choose? (\textbf{\fa{انتخاب} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{entekhâb kardan}.) To catch a cold? (\textbf{\fa{سرما} \fa{خوردن}}, \emph{sarmâ khordan}.) To get hurt? (\textbf{\fa{زخمی} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{zakhmi shodan}.) To swallow? (\textbf{\fa{قورت} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{qurt dâdan}.) To forget? (\textbf{\fa{فراموش} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{farâmush kardan}.) To teach? (\textbf{\fa{یاد} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{yâd dâdan}.) To fill? (\textbf{\fa{پر} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{por kardan}.) To hand in? (\textbf{\fa{تحویل} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{tahvil dâdan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
